## Summary

Enables the AMD Quark DeepSeek-V4-MXFP4 checkpoints ([amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4](https://huggingface.co/amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4), [amd/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-MXFP4](https://huggingface.co/amd/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-MXFP4)) on ROCm, including shared-expert fusion and MTP/EAGLE speculative decoding.

These checkpoints pre-quantize **shared expert to MXFP4**, matching the same spec as the routed experts, so it can be fused into the routed MoE. The checkpoints keep MTP block shared expert in blockwise FP8.

This PR also fixes a Quark MXFP4 MoE loading bug that silently dropped around 25% of every expert's FFN channels for running the [amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4](https://huggingface.co/amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4) checkpoint at TP8 (GSM8K 90%, vs base deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro GSM8K 96%).

## Changes

- **`layers/quantization/quark/schemes/quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.py`**: fixes padded TP loading. When aiter pads the per-rank intermediate width (e.g. 384 -> 512), each rank's real checkpoint channels now load at the head of its buffer, so the `intermediate_pad` tail aiter skips is actually zeros, instead of useful weights. Non-Quark schemes are unaffected. 
- **`layers/quantization/quark/quark.py`**:
  - DeepSeek-V4 fuses `wq_a` + `wkv` into `wqkv_a`, which has no per-layer spec of its own; it now inherits `wq_a`'s (blockwise FP8) spec instead of falling back to the global MXFP4 spec.
  - `can_fuse_shared_expert` also checks the NextN draft block (`model.decoder`), so the draft vetoes fusion when its FP8 shared expert doesn't match its MXFP4 routed experts. It also resolves the `shared_expert` vs `shared_experts` module spelling from the config's own keys; a misspelled lookup incorrectly fell through to the global spec.
- **`models/deepseek_v4.py`**:
  - `get_hf_to_sglang_mapper` maps Quark's checkpoint-named specs (`layers.N.attn.wq_a`, `mtp.0.ffn.experts.N.w1`, ...) onto sglang module names. It returns `None` for other formats, so the mapper does not affect other quant configs.
  - `_prepare_deepseek_v4_weights` renames Quark's FP8-block scales (`*.weight_scale`, e8m0) to the native DeepSeek-V4 spelling (`*.scale`). The existing native paths (attention `weight_scale_inv`, `e_proj`/`h_proj`, `wo_a` dequant) then apply unchanged.
- **`models/deepseek_v4_nextn.py`**: the draft's mapper places `mtp.0.*` under `model.decoder.*` (with `e_proj`/`h_proj` beside it), so the draft resolves its own per-layer specs, including the FP8 shared expert that vetoes draft fusion.
- **`test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_quark_config.py`**: CPU tests for the draft-only fusion veto, the `wqkv_a` spec, and padded TP loading. 



**Related Upstream Work**
- For the Quark MXFP4 MoE loading bug (`intermediate_pad` causing real weights to be dropped), the native DeepSeek-V4 FP4 path (`Fp8MoEMethod`) avoids this by aligning to 128 instead of 256 (PR #31450), so base DSV4 Pro TP8 runs unpadded at 384.
- PR #40811 added an unpadded Quark option for Kimi-K3, but only behind `SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT`, and it isn't safe to enable globally (only the FlyDSL kernels accept 128-aligned widths).


## Validation

GSM8K 8-shot with `lm_eval` (`local-completions`). Shared-expert fusion is on (`--enforce-shared-experts-fusion`) unless noted. MTP is EAGLE with `--speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`.

### DeepSeek-V4-Flash, TP4 (4xMI350X)

| Config | strict-match | flexible-extract |
|---|---|---|
| deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, fusion **off** | 92.87% | 92.80% |
| deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, fusion on | 95.38% | 95.30% |
| amd/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-MXFP4, fusion on | **95.75%** | **95.68%** |
| amd/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-MXFP4, fusion on + MTP | 95.22% | 95.15% |

### DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP8 (8xMI350X)

| Config | strict-match | flexible-extract |
|---|---|---|
| deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro, fusion **off** | 94.69% | 94.62% |
| deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro, fusion on | 95.75% | 95.68% |
| amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4, fusion on | 95.07% | 95.00% |
| amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4, fusion on + MTP | 95.07% | 95.00% |

## Performance

DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP8, 8xMI350X with EAGLE and acceptance pinned at 3.77 (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.77`) so both checkpoints run identical speculative work. Concurrency 48, 192 prompts per run, mean of 2 runs. **Both enable shared expert fusion.**

| Checkpoint | 1k/1k out tok/s | 1k/1k TPOT (ms) | 8k/1k out tok/s | 8k/1k TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro (*w/ online shared expert quant & fusion*) | 3342 | 13.0 | 1382 | 17.7 |
| amd/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-MXFP4 | **3369 (+0.8%)** | **12.9** | **1392 (+0.7%)** | **17.5** |

## Reproduction

### Launch server

```bash
SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A=0 SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=unified_kv_triton AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0 \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path <model-dir> --tp <tp-size> \
  --attention-backend dsv4 --page-size 256 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.15 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 \
  --enforce-shared-experts-fusion \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
# + MTP: --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4
```

### Accuracy

```bash
lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=<model-dir>,base_url=http://localhost:30000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=128,max_retries=10,max_gen_toks=2048,timeout=60000,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None \
  --batch_size auto --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 8
```

@@ -282,6 +282,10 @@ def _build_excluded_fp8_config(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional["Fp8Config"]:
     "model.language_model.layers.0",
 )
 
+# A NextN draft builds its block under ``model.decoder``; only the draft's own
+# weight-name mapper renames per-layer specs onto it, so the target never matches.
+_MOE_SHARED_EXPERT_QUANT_DRAFT_BASES: tuple[str, ...] = ("model.decoder",)
+
 _SHARED_EXPERT_BODY_PROJ_SUFFIXES: tuple[str, ...] = (
     "gate_proj",
     "up_proj",
@@ -381,9 +385,15 @@ def apply_weight_name_mapper(self, hf_to_sglang_mapper):
 
         layer_quant_config = self.quant_config.get("layer_quant_config")
         if layer_quant_config:
-            self.quant_config["layer_quant_config"] = hf_to_sglang_mapper.apply_dict(
-                layer_quant_config
-            )
+            layer_quant_config = hf_to_sglang_mapper.apply_dict(layer_quant_config)
+            # DeepSeek-V4 fuses wq_a + wkv into one wqkv_a module that has no spec
+            # of its own; both halves share one, so mirror it.
+            for name in list(layer_quant_config):
+                if name.endswith(".wq_a"):
+                    layer_quant_config.setdefault(
+                        name.removesuffix(".wq_a") + ".wqkv_a", layer_quant_config[name]
+                    )
+            self.quant_config["layer_quant_config"] = layer_quant_config
 
         if self.kv_cache_group:
             self.kv_cache_group = hf_to_sglang_mapper.apply_list(self.kv_cache_group)
@@ -1054,15 +1064,26 @@ def can_fuse_shared_expert(self) -> bool:
         if not layer_quant_config:
             return True
 
-        # Compare routed vs shared specs at layer 0 (stub module needed by
-        # _find_matched_config; an unmatched name -> ValueError -> cannot fuse).
+        # DeepSeek-family modules are "shared_experts"; a misspelled lookup would
+        # fall through to the global spec and hide a mismatch.
+        shared_module = (
+            "shared_experts"
+            if any(".shared_experts." in name for name in layer_quant_config)
+            else "shared_expert"
+        )
+
+        # Compare routed vs shared specs at layer 0 and the draft block (stub module
+        # needed by _find_matched_config; an unmatched name -> ValueError -> cannot fuse).
         lookup_stub = torch.nn.Module()
         try:
-            for base in _MOE_SHARED_EXPERT_QUANT_LAYER0_BASES:
+            for base in (
+                _MOE_SHARED_EXPERT_QUANT_LAYER0_BASES
+                + _MOE_SHARED_EXPERT_QUANT_DRAFT_BASES
+            ):
                 moe_name = f"{base}.mlp.experts"
                 moe_cfg = self._find_matched_config(moe_name, lookup_stub)
                 for suffix in _SHARED_EXPERT_BODY_PROJ_SUFFIXES:
-                    shared_name = f"{base}.mlp.shared_expert.{suffix}"
+                    shared_name = f"{base}.mlp.{shared_module}.{suffix}"
                     shared_cfg = self._find_matched_config(shared_name, lookup_stub)
                     if not deep_compare(moe_cfg, shared_cfg):
                         return False

@@ -59,6 +59,42 @@
     from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
 
 
+def _pad_tp_chunks(
+    loaded_weight: torch.Tensor, *, dim: int, tp_size: int, padded: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Zero-pad each of the tp_size equal chunks of loaded_weight along dim to padded."""
+    real = loaded_weight.shape[dim] // tp_size
+    if real == padded:
+        return loaded_weight
+    assert real * tp_size == loaded_weight.shape[dim] and real < padded
+    chunks = loaded_weight.unflatten(dim, (tp_size, real))
+    pad_shape = list(chunks.shape)
+    pad_shape[dim + 1] = padded - real
+    return torch.cat([chunks, chunks.new_zeros(pad_shape)], dim=dim + 1).flatten(
+        dim, dim + 1
+    )
+
+
